//: ARRIVAL ORDER - not her numbering. The array position IS the schedule:
entry 1 unlocks first (12 days out) and the LAST entry lands on her birthday.
Her song 1 (Sajde) is therefore last in this file, on purpose - it is the one
the countdown ends on, the 27th. Song 12 arrives first, on the 16th.
Filenames keep HER numbering (01-sajde = her song 1) so they match the list
she sent; the schedule comes from position, not from the filename.
The "search" field is a hint for `npm run songs:enrich` only - a bare title is
often ambiguous (three films have a song called Raabta).
